updates.note: Management reiterates the goal to reach 10% export turnover in the next five years.
updates.quote: we want to finally aim at 10% of our revenues through export. So, we are working systematically to see that we reach that goal in next five years.

updates.note: Management reiterates R&D investment of more than INR 2,200 crores for the year.
updates.quote: more than INR2,200 crores R&D budget we have allocated for this year

updates.note: Management reiterates the defense to non-defense ratio of 90:10.
updates.quote: capex more than INR1,200 crores with a typical defence non-defence business of 90:10.

updates.note: Management reiterates revenue growth guidance of 15% for the year.
updates.quote: revenue growth of 15%, EBITDA margin 21% to 23%... So, this guidance definitely we are working towards and I am confident we will achieve

updates.note: Management reiterates 28% EBITDA margin guidance for the full year.
updates.quote: current year EBITDA margin guidance we have given of 28%, we remain at that... Overall on a yearly basis, we maintain the EBITDA margin of 28%

updates.note: Management reiterates order inflow guidance of INR 55,000 plus crores for the year.
updates.quote: So, that is INR55,000 plus crores, including QRSAM. So, we are sticking to that

updates.note: Management reiterates capex guidance of INR 1,200 plus crores for the year.
updates.quote: INR1,200 plus crores we are investing under capex

updates.note: Management reiterates defense to non-defense ratio of 90:10 for the year.
updates.quote: capex more than INR1,200 crores with a typical defence non-defence business of 90:10.

new_promises.statement: We aim to fetch around USD 300 million out of export leads this year.
new_promises.quote: this year we have given our internal guidance of around USD300 million we should definitely fetch out of the leads which we are having.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
